ranked.headline: Resolving gene regulation by cell type, tissue, and condition across omics data
ranked.summary: Context-resolved models now predict splicing, enhancer-promoter contacts, and eQTL effects across tissues, cell types, and conditions.

ranked.headline: Technical distortions in omics data are corrected to recover biological structure
ranked.summary: Batch effects, missing values and spatial tissue artifacts remain barriers to recovering biological structure from sparse and integrated omics data.

ranked.headline: Pretrained and graph models target ligand binding, docking and pocket prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend learned structural representations to ligand affinity, nucleic acid docking, and pocket druggability and allostery.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings reused for annotation and cross-modal transfer
ranked.summary: Protein-trained models are now transferred across modalities and evaluated on non-redundant fold benchmarks in recent preprints.

ranked.headline: Encoding prior knowledge directly into biomedical models across diverse data modalities
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple model structure to population priors and biological context across blood, imaging, metabolomic, and histology data.

ranked.headline: Read-based tools classify pathogens and strains directly from sequencing reads
ranked.summary: Refinement methods, interface layers and benchmarks are appearing alongside new workflows for strain-level and amplicon read classification.

ranked.headline: Haplotype and k-mer methods infer genomic relationships from sequence structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method address pangenome expansion, viral alignment, diploid assembly and population distances from sequence.

ranked.headline: Recovering cell-state dynamics from single-cell snapshots lacking time resolution
ranked.summary: Snapshot scRNA-seq, scATAC, and spatial data now support inference of transitions, fates, and regulatory drivers without time-resolved sampling.

ranked.headline: Synthetic simulation data train calibration and transfer learning for biological models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply synthetic trajectories to rare disease model calibration and to biological time-series transfer learning.

ranked.headline: Biomolecular models increasingly encode biological context and expose what they learn
ranked.summary: Recent work tests whether learned biomolecular models capture biological context and whether their benchmarks expose what they actually learn.

ranked.headline: Recovering unobserved cell dynamics from snapshots, static scRNA-seq, and images
ranked.summary: Several May 2026 preprints pair optimal transport or flow matching with single-cell and imaging data to infer unobserved temporal trajectories.

ranked.headline: Automated parametrization and input generation for all-atom and coarse-grained MD models
ranked.summary: Automated generation of MD topologies and force field parameters is extending to dihedrals, cyclic peptides, and coarse-grained structure-based models.

ranked.headline: Reducing lipidomic and transcriptomic data to interpretable metabolic health readouts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study convert lipidomic, transcriptomic and multi-omic data into metabolic health readouts.

ranked.headline: Transformer and flow models advance de novo peptide sequencing from mass spectra
ranked.summary: Learned models now infer peptide identity from MS/MS spectra, adding open PTM discovery and interpretable retention modeling.

ranked.headline: Biomedical prediction models treat uncertainty and interpretability as explicit outputs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair Bayesian, rule-based, and conformal methods with clinical and genomic prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Long-read and alignment methods refine variant calling in homologous genomic regions
ranked.summary: Assembly-derived SV panels enable GWAS of structural variants, and alignment refinement targets homologous regions where short-read mapping is ambiguous.

ranked.headline: Markov models map conformational pathways linking mutations to altered protein function
ranked.summary: Simulation-based kinetic models now connect single mutations and sequence features to shifts in conformational flux and function.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale pipelines expose methodological bias and deep-time regulatory evolution
ranked.summary: Scalable pipelines now span thousands of animal genomes and deep-time fossil and plant datasets, exposing methodological bias.

ranked.headline: Multi-omic profiling maps regulatory states in aging, disease and senescence
ranked.summary: Paired single-cell and multi-omic datasets now link transcription factor networks and transcript diversity to age, disease, and senescence states.

ranked.headline: Computational models prioritize human disease variants for clinical review
ranked.summary: Sequence, structure, and language-model features are being used to rank human variants for clinical interpretation and guide design in editing workflows.

ranked.headline: Recovery profiles and latent probes test what fMRI and neural encoding models capture
ranked.summary: Accuracy alone masks model-brain mismatch, prompting recovery-profile and latent-space evaluations of encoding models against brain data.

ranked.headline: Leakage-aware benchmarks standardize evaluation of prediction and design tools
ranked.summary: Blinded and held-out benchmarks are exposing leakage and inconsistent evaluation across prediction and protein design tools.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and bias control reshape RNA and protein ligand binding prediction
ranked.summary: Structure-based RNA and protein ligand modeling now pairs curated benchmarks with bias-controlled decoys to test what models actually learn.

ranked.headline: Deep learning and k-mer pipelines for gene annotation and phylogenomic alignment
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published benchmark test automated tools for gene annotation, phylogenomic alignment, and draft metabolic model reconstruction.

ranked.headline: Physics-based polymer models separate null confinement from specific chromatin folding
ranked.summary: Polymer null models are being used to separate confinement effects from specific interactions in bacterial and eukaryotic chromosome organization.

ranked.headline: Latent infection states inferred from PCR-only, titration, and incidence data
ranked.summary: Bayesian state-space and hidden-state models now recover infectiousness and infection risk from indirect assay and surveillance data.

ranked.headline: Calibrating sequencing and mapping biases before inferring genomic and transcriptomic features
ranked.summary: Several preprints calibrate, harmonize, or benchmark data representations such as Hi-C maps and RNA-seq inputs before biological inference.

ranked.headline: Learned models couple histology with spatial transcriptomics at subcellular resolution
ranked.summary: High-resolution platforms demand single-cell expression assignment, which histology-coupled learned models now address directly.

ranked.headline: Learned models and simulation probe protein flexibility, disorder and binding energetics
ranked.summary: Graph neural networks and AlphaFold-family ensembles are now benchmarked against NMR, X-ray, cryo-EM and MD flexibility data.

ranked.headline: Bayesian and normalization-invariant methods refine flux and compositional inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints tackle model uncertainty in 13C-MFA and compositional bias in sequencing data, with network methods extending metabolic inference.

ranked.headline: ML models prioritize sequences and perturbations for experimental follow-up
ranked.summary: Community benchmarks and new Perturb-seq data test whether learned models can rank T cell perturbations and antibody sequence features reliably.

ranked.headline: Phylogenetic and haplotype structure informs pathogen fitness and transmission inference
ranked.summary: Sequence sets of over 100,000 influenza genomes and dengue haplotype data now support quantitative inference of fitness and transmission.

ranked.headline: Graph methods encode biological priors via layers, explanations, and edge statistics
ranked.summary: Biological network models increasingly encode domain priors in graph structure rather than relying on generic node embeddings.

ranked.headline: Stereochemistry-aware drug representations for affinity and side-effect prediction
ranked.summary: Three preprints posted May 18–21, 2026 explore stereochemical and structural molecular encodings for drug-target, side-effect, and similarity tasks.

ranked.headline: Inferring spiking neuron parameters and timing from data at network and cell scales
ranked.summary: Recent items pair mechanistic spiking simulation with learned or optimised inference to fit models to spike times, voltage traces, and oscillations.

ranked.headline: Graph pangenomes expose structural variation underlying trait association in crops
ranked.summary: Graph-based pangenomes now resolve structural variants that linear references miss, sharpening association and expression inference in plants.

ranked.headline: MD resolves Fe2+ binding sites and accelerates long-range electrostatics
ranked.summary: Recent items pair free-energy simulations of frataxin metal coordination with faster Ewald electrostatics and coarse-grained asphalt force fields.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and statistical models prioritize viral and parasite genomic variation
ranked.summary: Pangenome, k-mer, and deep mutational scanning methods now enable cheaper, targeted variant prioritization across pathogens.

ranked.headline: Making uncertainty and benchmark performance explicit in omics inference methods
ranked.summary: Omics inference tools increasingly report uncertainty and standardized benchmarks, so reliability can be tested rather than assumed.

ranked.headline: Baseline and parameter choices shape inference in biological network and pattern models
ranked.summary: Recent work tests how sampling baselines and fitting schemes shape conclusions drawn from parameterized biological models.
